subject: Org access playbook stitch-up — AuroraFin onboarding
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@aurorafin.com>, Aurora Infra Team <infra@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Org access playbook stitch-up — AuroraFin onboarding

Hi Claire / Infra team,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Monica and I put together a short 'org access playbook' draft to streamline the SSO/SCIM/service-account parts of your onboarding. The goal is to align on a minimal, auditable cutover plan so your security and infra teams can validate before we flip traffic.

Quick agenda for a 30m call, if that helps:
- Confirm IdP metadata (SAML): issuer, ACS, certificate (Okta Okta).
- SCIM provisioning: service account + least-privilege scopes and expected user attribute mapping.
- IP allowlists / egress constraints for Redwood service endpoints (list of CIDRs).
- Service account usage patterns and KMS/HSM key constraints.
- Cutover window and rollback criteria.

Could you please:
1) Share the SAML metadata (or an Okta metadata XML) and confirm whether you support SP-initiated only or both?
2) Confirm who will create the SCIM service account and whether it needs org-level admin scopes or a more restricted set (we usually recommend the 'SCIM provisioning' scoped role).
3) Send the IP ranges your network team will allow outbound to; we have regional endpoints but can provide a short list.

I've attached the current org-access-playbook-v0.3.pdf (working draft) and linked a Google folder with the runbook templates.

If a call is easiest, proposed slots: Mon 7/6 10–10:30 PT or Thu 7/9 2–2:30 PT.

Thanks — happy to coordinate.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: org-access-playbook-v0.3.pdf (pdf, 230KB)

From: Claire Huang <claire@aurorafin.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Aurora Infra Team <infra@aurorafin.com>, Procurement <procure@aurorafin.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Org access playbook stitch-up — AuroraFin onboarding

Hi Aditya — thanks for the clear agenda.

Short answers up front:
- IdP: Okta (org: aurorafin-prod). I will send Okta metadata (XML) by EOD; we support SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows.
- SCIM: Our infra team will create the SCIM service account; we'd like to scope it to user.read/write, group.read for now — procurement will not approve org-admin level access.
- IP allowlist: our firewall team requires destination CIDRs and ports; I'll attach a spreadsheet with our source IP expectations.

I've attached AuroraFin's security questionnaire (aurorafin-security-qna.xlsx) — procurement wants that answered before we finalize the SOW. Also include the minimum permissions for the SCIM service account so we can include that in our change request.

Proposed cutover windows: we prefer low-traffic weekday evenings; 7/8 20:00–21:30 PT is an option, or 7/9 14:00–15:30 PT if you need daytime.

I'll loop in our security ops if we need to exchange signed attestations or provide SOC2 evidence.

Claire Huang
Head of Platform Operations
AuroraFin

Attachments: aurorafin-security-qna.xlsx (xlsx, 48KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 08:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Org access playbook stitch-up — AuroraFin onboarding

Looping back internal-only: Claire confirmed Okta + procurement questionnaire. We need engineering to tentatively reserve the 7/8 evening window and carve out an SRE for the cutover. Ben — can you assign an SRE and confirm runbook owner? Marissa — CS will drive questionnaire responses with the customer; I will own scheduling.

Checklist for engineering:
- Validate SAML metadata import flow and a test SP in our staging.
- Prepare a SCIM role with the requested scopes and a service account token rotation plan.
- Produce a short firewall/cidr doc to hand to Aurora's infra team.

Please confirm by EOD so we can tell Claire we're green.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

(Internal note: keep responses short and prescriptive.)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire@aurorafin.com>, Aurora Infra Team <infra@aurorafin.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Org access playbook stitch-up — AuroraFin onboarding

Thanks all — quick consolidated next steps and owners: 

1) Claire / Aurora: share Okta metadata XML and procurement questionnaire answers (Claire) — target: 2026-06-28 EOD.
2) Infra (Aurora): confirm allowed destination CIDRs for Redwood endpoints and whether you require fixed IPs or a proxy (infra@aurorafin.com).
3) Redwood Eng (Ben): create SCIM role (user.read/write, group.read) + service account; post the IAM policy in the shared Drive.
4) Redwood SE (Aditya): set up a staging SP and test IdP-initiated and SP-initiated flows; I will drop test steps in the runbook.
5) CS (Marissa / Monica): complete procurement worksheet and coordinate SOW signatures; share DocuSign link once ready.

I've uploaded a concise cutover checklist to the Drive (link above) and attached the Okta metadata XML once Claire sends it. Also adding a suggested rollback criteria block: two consecutive failed auth exchanges after five minutes -> automatic rollback to previous routing.

Proposed firm cutover: 2026-07-08 20:00–21:30 PT (tentative) — confirm by 2026-07-01 so we can lock SRE.

Links / attachments:
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B-example-playbook
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/aurorafin-9832
- DocuSign placeholder: https://www.docusign.net/example/aurorafin-sow

Thanks — will follow up with the staging playbook and a minimal test matrix.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: saml-metadata-okta.xml (pending from customer)
